inclusion_criteria: Persistent DOI or canonical book record for external references
Exact bibliographic match to the frozen manuscript inventory
Direct relevance to at least one bounded sentence in Section 2
Internal companion record retained only for shared-asset and method-distinction disclosure
exclusion_criteria: Title-only leads not already present in the frozen verified inventory
Sources whose move semantics could not distinguish atomic substitution from separate insertion and deletion
Generic cybersecurity sources or cybersecurity relabeling
Sources used to imply universal superiority or exhaustive novelty without full-text evidence
Search results lacking verifiable authorship venue year or persistent identifier

search_outcome.reason: Live external discovery was unavailable. The stage therefore preserves the verified frozen bibliography and narrows unsupported absence and move-semantics claims rather than inventing new citations.
limitations: No verified variable-neighborhood-search source was added.
No external source was found or imported for matched-compute evaluation; the paper's comparison budget remains grounded in its own preregistered protocol and archive.
No exhaustive literature-wide claim about absence of atomic substitution is supported.
